comment: Only the first of the eight patterns is active on a fresh module (beat.cpp:168); the others are switched in by double-clicking their cell in the pattern selector. Every control is on the display — mode tabs, a sixteen-step grid, length dots, a pattern selector and a repeats bar — and none of it is a parameter, so none of it has a position in the widget lists and none can be reached by clicking for help.
